title: Old town walking tour
instructions: Bir rehber yürüyüş turunu anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; sırayı, sayıları ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Good morning and welcome to our walking tour of the old town. My name is Daniel.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Our tour will take about two hours, and we'll walk about three kilometres.

script.speaker: s
script.text: First, we'll visit the cathedral. It was built more than seven hundred years ago. You can go inside, but please be quiet and don't take photos with a flash.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Then we'll walk to the old market, where you'll have thirty minutes of free time. Try the local cheese—it's famous!

script.speaker: s
script.text: After that, we'll cross the river and go up to the castle. There are a hundred and twenty steps, so take your time.

script.speaker: s
script.text: From the top, you can see the whole city.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The tour finishes at the castle at about twelve thirty. If you have any questions, just ask me. Let's go!

questions.evidence: Our tour will take about two hours

questions.feedback: Katedral yedi yüz yıldan daha eski.

questions.prompt: How much free time is there at the market?
questions.feedback: Pazarda otuz dakika serbest zaman var.

questions.feedback: Tur saat on iki buçuk civarı kalede bitiyor.
